form.label: On-demand cleanup: message sent vs execution
form.description: Compares index=prod events ("New on-demand cleanup job for user … message has been sent") with index=platform_engr_prod ("On demand cleanup job … executed with state"). Correlation key: user id (text between "user" and "message") matches the segment before ! inside the executed job id in brackets. Tune indexes and the time picker for your environment.

search.query: index=$idx_sent$ "New on-demand cleanup job for user" "message has been sent" | rex field=_raw "for user (?<user_key>[^\s]+) message" | stats count as total
index=$idx_exec$ "On demand cleanup job" "executed with state" | stats count as total

index=$idx_sent$ "New on-demand cleanup job for user" "message has been sent" | rex field=_raw "for user (?<user_key>[^\s]+) message" | stats count as c_sent | appendcols [ search index=$idx_exec$ "On demand cleanup job" "executed with state" | stats count as c_exec ] | eval delta=c_sent-c_exec | fields delta

panel.title: Pending (sent, no execution for user_key in window)

search.query: (index=$idx_sent$ "New on-demand cleanup job for user" "message has been sent") | rex field=_raw "for user (?<user_key>[^\s]+) message" | eval stream="sent" | fields _time user_key stream | append [ search (index=$idx_exec$ "On demand cleanup job" "executed with state") | rex field=_raw "On demand cleanup job \[(?<job_id>[^\]]+)\]" | eval user_key=mvindex(split(job_id,"!"),0) | eval stream="executed" | fields _time user_key stream ] | stats earliest(eval(if(stream="sent",_time,null()))) as first_sent earliest(eval(if(stream="executed",_time,null()))) as first_exec by user_key | where isnotnull(first_sent) AND isnull(first_exec) | stats count as pending

(index=$idx_sent$ "New on-demand cleanup job for user" "message has been sent") | rex field=_raw "for user (?<user_key>[^\s]+) message" | eval series="job_sent" | fields _time series | append [ search (index=$idx_exec$ "On demand cleanup job" "executed with state") | eval series="job_executed" | fields _time series ] | timechart span=15m count by series

panel.title: Non-matching: sent events with no execution for same user_key in window

search.query: index=$idx_sent$ "New on-demand cleanup job for user" "message has been sent" | rex field=_raw "for user (?<user_key>[^\s]+) message" | join type=left max=0 user_key [ search index=$idx_exec$ "On demand cleanup job" "executed with state" | rex field=_raw "On demand cleanup job \[(?<job_id>[^\]]+)\]" | eval user_key=mvindex(split(job_id,"!"),0) | dedup user_key | eval _exec_match=1 | fields user_key _exec_match ] | where isnull(_exec_match) | eval mismatch_type="sent_no_exec_in_window" | table _time mismatch_type user_key host sourcetype _raw | sort - _time

panel.title: Non-matching: executed events with no sent message for same user_key in window

search.query: index=$idx_exec$ "On demand cleanup job" "executed with state" | rex field=_raw "On demand cleanup job \[(?<job_id>[^\]]+)\]" | eval user_key=mvindex(split(job_id,"!"),0) | rex field=_raw "state=(?<exec_state>[^,\s\]]+)" | join type=left max=0 user_key [ search index=$idx_sent$ "New on-demand cleanup job for user" "message has been sent" | rex field=_raw "for user (?<user_key>[^\s]+) message" | dedup user_key | eval _sent_match=1 | fields user_key _sent_match ] | where isnull(_sent_match) | eval mismatch_type="exec_only_in_window" | table _time mismatch_type user_key job_id exec_state host sourcetype _raw | sort - _time

index=$idx_sent$ "New on-demand cleanup job for user" "message has been sent" | rex field=_raw "for user (?<user_key>[^\s]+) message" | table _time host sourcetype user_key _raw | sort - _time | head 30

index=$idx_exec$ "On demand cleanup job" "executed with state" | rex field=_raw "On demand cleanup job \[(?<job_id>[^\]]+)\]" | eval user_key=mvindex(split(job_id,"!"),0) | rex field=_raw "state=(?<exec_state>[^,\s\]]+)" | table _time host sourcetype user_key job_id exec_state _raw | sort - _time | head 30
